summary: System menu and display handling overhaul, SDL model on our mockup (task)
author: pm
body:
Goal (user, 2026-11-25): "start the system menu and window handling overhaul to match that of SDL but with our system menu mockup". Mockup .claude/scratch/coordinator/sysmenu_mockup/b2.png (dropdowns point left collapsed, down open).

Plan, research and decisions: .claude/design/plans/system-menu-display-overhaul.md. Refresh-rate decision still open.

**Done when:** every sub-task is done and the menu, staging and window modes work in game on Windows, with Linux built and checked.

**Done, 2026-11-26:** all sub-tasks done - HH-0115 3a3c150b, HH-0116 d2583b1b, HH-0117 b9a906a6, HH-0118/HH-0119 e80c0a34, HH-0120 e174ed23, HH-0121 verified (Linux), plus HH-0123 bb7b52e8 found on the way. Not verified on any platform: exclusive fullscreen with a real refresh-rate switch on Windows.
